title: fix(preflight): convert_to_r12 returned an empty DXF for consolidated input
intent: The /auto_fix convert_to_r12 fix copied entities into a fresh R12 document with add_foreign_entity. That call accepts an LWPOLYLINE into an R12 document -- so the in-memory count looks right -- and the writer drops it on save, because R12 has no LWPOLYLINE. Measured on the live consolidator's own output (25 LWPOLYLINE contours from app.cam.layer_consolidator): the returned file contained ZERO entities while fixes_applied reported 'Converted to R12 format'. Layer definitions and text styles were lost the same way. Replaces the loop with an explicit converter that carries layer and style tables, converts LWPOLYLINE to POLYLINE with points/bulges/widths/closure/elevation, verifies the SAVED file against the source's meaning including style definitions (font, not just style name), and fails closed on unverified R12-native types (INSERT/blocks, ATTDEF, SOLID, 3DFACE, 3D/mesh POLYLINE), custom linetypes, and non-empty paper-space layouts.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds app/cam/r12_convert.py (explicit LWPOLYLINE->POLYLINE; layer and style tables carried before entities; saved-file semantic verification including style-table font/width/oblique/flags; UnconvertibleEntity for unverified natives and paper-space geometry; losses R12's format forces reported as format_limited_layer_attributes). Rewires the convert_to_r12 branch to use it, surfaces its two named failures as 422 and 500 instead of returning a file, moves the 'Converted to R12' message to AFTER verification (it was announced before the conversion ran), and returns a conversion_report so a caller can check rather than trust a sentence. Adds endpoint tests on the REOPENED returned file plus converter tests that a same-name/wrong-font style fails verification, INSERT+block is refused, paper space is refused, and 3D/ATTDEF/SOLID/3DFACE are refused.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The existing test_auto_fix_convert_to_r12 asserted only that 'R12' appears in fixes_applied, which passes on an empty file -- that is how this reached production. ezdxf's auditor also reports the empty output as clean, so nothing downstream could detect it.

commands_run: TestClient end-to-end on the live consolidator's own output (25 LWPOLYLINE, R2000): HTTP 200, returned file AC1009 with 25 POLYLINE, BODY_OUTLINE defined, verification clean; before the change the same input returned an empty file
TestClient negative case (SPLINE): HTTP 422, no fixed_dxf_base64 in the response

python3 -m pytest tests/test_r12_convert.py -q --noconftest -o addopts= -> 12 passed (style font round-trip, same-name/wrong-font FidelityError, INSERT refuse, paperspace refuse, 3D POLYLINE refuse, ATTDEF/SOLID/3DFACE refuse, custom linetype refuse, verified LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/POINT round-trip, 2D POLYLINE vertex Z)
python3 -m pytest tests/test_dxf_preflight_endpoint_smoke.py -k convert_to_r12 -q --noconftest -o addopts= -> 7 passed (consolidated contour+font, SPLINE 422, INSERT 422, paperspace 422)

files.intent: R12 converter: explicit LWPOLYLINE->POLYLINE, resource carry, saved-file semantic verification including style-table definitions, fail-closed on unverified natives, INSERT/blocks, 3D/mesh polylines, custom linetypes, and paper-space geometry.
Replace the add_foreign_entity conversion loop; report the fix only after the saved file is verified; surface refusal as 422 and fidelity failure as 500.
files.behavior_change: yes - convert_to_r12 now refuses unsupported input instead of returning a lossy file

Converter-level regressions: same-name/wrong-font style fails verification; INSERT+block, paper space, 3D POLYLINE, ATTDEF, SOLID, 3DFACE, and custom linetypes are refused; verified LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/POINT round-trip.
